svg.text: Each mnemonic is written once per data type it supports (BI, BY, H, W, F, D), which is how 252 instructions become 1097 opcode variants. Counts: instructions · variants.
Sources: ND-05.009.4 ND-500 Reference Manual; nd500x instructions.json. Classes follow the nd500x emulator grouping.
